title: Abundance in numerical dimension one for terminal threefolds in positive characteristic
summary: Let X be a projective ℚ-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 3. We prove the numerical-dimension-one case of abundance: if K X is nef with $`\nu(K_X)=1`$, then K X is semiample and $`\kappa(X,K_X)=1`$.
family_title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one

review.reason: Proves the numerical-dimension-one abundance case for terminal threefolds in positive characteristic.
